sections.text: Završeni su radovi na Sajlovu, čime su se stekli uslovi za povratak autobusa  linije 14 na redovnu trasu.

text_translations.en: The works on Sajlovo have been completed, which created the conditions for the return of bus line 14 to the regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 14 - Return to the regular route

sections.text: JGSP „Novi Sad“ obaveštava putnike da će od 22. juna 2026. godine  autobusi saobraćati po organizaciji prevoza za letnji period. Novi red vožnje podrazumeva vremenske korekcije autobuskih polazaka,  koje su usklađene sa potrebama korisnika usluga prevoza u narednim mesecima i očekivanim smanjenjem broja putnika zbog korišćenja godišnjih odmora i letnjeg raspusta.

text_translations.en: JGSP "Novi Sad" informs passengers that from June 22, 2026, buses will run according to the transportation organization for the summer period. The new timetable implies time corrections of bus departures, which are aligned with the needs of users of transportation services in the coming months and the expected decrease in the number of passengers due to the use of annual vacations and summer vacation.

title: Linija 52 – Trajna izmena trase kroz Ulicu Dragoslava Srejovića

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 22. 06. 2026. godine menja se trasa linije broj 52 (Novi Sad-Veternik).

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, as of June 22, 2026, the route of line number 52 (Novi Sad-Veternik) is changing.

sections.text: Ž.stanica-Bulevar oslobođenja-Futoška-Bulevar Evrope-Radomira Raše Radujkova-Bulevar Jovana Dučića-Dragoslava Srejovića-Tome Maksimovića-Kralja Petra prvog-Svetozara Miletića-Vojvode Putnika-Vojvode Bojovića.

text_translations.en: Railway Station - Boulevard of Liberation - Futoška - Boulevard of Europe - Radomir Raša Radujkova - Boulevard of Jovan Dučić - Dragoslav Srejović - Tom Maksimović - King Peter the First - Svetozar Miletić - Vojvode Putnik - Vojvode Bojović.

sections.text: Vojvode Bojovića-Školska-Braće Tokin-Omladinska- Kralja Petra prvog -Tome Maksimovića-Dragoslava Srejovića-Radomira Raše Radujkova-Bulevar Evrope-Futoška-Bulevar oslobođenja-Ž.stanica

text_translations.en: Vojvode Bojović-Scholska-Braće Tokin-Youth-Kralja Peter the First-Tome Maksimović-Dragoslav Srejović-Radomir Raša Radujkova-Bulevar Evrope-Futoška-Bulevar oslobođenja-Ž.stanica

title_translations.en: Line 52 - Permanent change of route through Dragoslav Srejovića Street

title: Linije 10, 14, 41, 42, 43 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta „Rumenački put – Avijatičarska“

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 04. 06. 2026. godine privremeno se ukida stajalište „Rumenački put – Avijatičarska“.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the stop "Rumenački put - Avijatičarska" will be temporarily abolished from June 4, 2026.

sections.text: Navedeno stajalište linija 10, 14, 41, 42 i 43 neće biti u funkciji do završetka radova na pristupnim putevima za privremenu železničku stanicu.

text_translations.en: The mentioned stop of lines 10, 14, 41, 42 and 43 will not be in operation until the completion of works on the access roads for the temporary railway station.

title_translations.en: Lines 10, 14, 41, 42, 43 - Temporary cancellation of the "Rumenački put - Avijatičarska" stop

title: Linija 43 – Ukida se stara okretnica u Stepanovićevu

sections.text: Nakon izgradnje dva nova stajališta u Ulici Stepe Stepanovića u Stepanovićevu, autobusi na liniji 43 (Novi Sad-Stepanovićevo) od 03. 06. 2026. godine neće koristiti staru okretnicu.

text_translations.en: After the construction of two new stops in Stepe Stepanovića Street in Stepanovićevo, buses on route 43 (Novi Sad-Stepanovićevo) will not use the old turnstile from June 3, 2026.

sections.text: Nova stajališta su izgrađena u blizini stare okretnice (jedno stajalište za smer iz Novog Sada, a drugo za smer iz Stepanovićeva).

text_translations.en: New stops were built near the old turnpike (one stop for the direction from Novi Sad, and the other for the direction from Stepanovićevo).

title_translations.en: Line 43 – The old turnpike in Stepanovićevo is being abolished

title: Linija 14 – Izmena trase na polascima do i od Veternika

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 20. 05. do 20. 06. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 14 (Centar-Sajlovo-Veternik) na polascima koji saobraćaju do i od Veternika.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from May 20 to June 20, 2026, the route of bus line number 14 (Centar-Sajlovo-Veternik) will be temporarily changed on departures to and from Veternik.

sections.text: Zbog zabrane odvijanja saobraćaja u delu Ulice kralja Petra prvog u Veterniku (od Ulice Vase Eškićevića prema Sajlovu), navedeni polasci SAOBRAĆAĆE SKRAĆENO DO I OD OKRETNICE NA SAJLOVU.

text_translations.en: Due to the prohibition of traffic in the part of Kralja Petar irvo Street in Veternik (from Vasa Eškićević Street towards Sajlovo), the mentioned departures WILL BE REDUCED TRAFFIC TO AND FROM THE ROUNDBACK ON Sajlovo.

title_translations.en: Line 14 - Route change on departures to and from Veternik

title: Linije 6, 11B – Privremena izmena trase na keju (druga faza radova)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 19. 05. do 15. 08. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase linija broj 6 i 11B zbog druge faze radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog vrelovoda GRS-TO JUG, od Varadinskog mosta do Ulice Marka Miljanova.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from May 19 to August 15, 2026, the routes of lines 6 and 11B will be temporarily changed due to the second phase of works on the reconstruction of the connecting spring pipeline GRS-TO JUG, from Varadinski bridge to Marka Miljanova Street.

sections.text: LINIJA 6

text_translations.en: LINE 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Marka Miljanova ulaziti u kružni tok, saobraćati pravo preko Žeželjevog mosta, skretati desno na Kej skojevaca, zatim desno na Varadinski most, produžavati Bulevarom Mihajla Pupina i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will enter the roundabout from Marko Miljanova Street, drive straight across the Žeželje Bridge, turn right onto the Skojevac Quay, then right onto the Varadinski Bridge, continue along the Mihajla Pupin Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

sections.text: LINIJA 11 A

text_translations.en: LINE 11 A

sections.text: Autobusi će od Beogradskog keja saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on a regular route from Belgrade Quay.

sections.text: LINIJA 11 B

text_translations.en: LINE 11 B

sections.text: Autobusi će do Ulice Marka Miljanova saobraćati redovnom trasom, ulaziti u kružni tok, nastavljati pravo preko Žeželjevog mosta, skretati desno na Kej skojevaca, zatim desno na Varadinski most i produžavati pravo Bulevarom Mihajla Pupina, skretati levo u Ulicu Žarka Zrenjanina, zatim pravo Stražilovskom ulicom i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses will travel on the regular route to Marka Miljanova Street, enter the roundabout, continue straight across the Žeželje Bridge, turn right onto the Skojevac Quay, then right onto the Varadinski Bridge and continue straight along Mihajla Pupina Boulevard, turn left onto Žarka Zrenjanina Street, then straight onto Stražilovska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆE STAJALIŠTE „BULEVAR MIHAJLA PUPINA-DUNAVSKI PARK“  NA BULEVARU MIHAJLA PUPINA.

text_translations.en: THE EXISTING STOP "BOULEVARD MIHAJLA PUPINA-DUNAVSKI PARK" ON BOULEVARD MIHAJLA PUPINA WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11B – Temporary change of route on the quay (second phase of works)

title: Linije 11A, 11B - Uspostavljen saobraćaj kroz Ulicu Jovana Cvijića

sections.text: Autobusi na linijama 11a i 11b ponovo saobraćaju redovnom trasom kroz Ulicu Jovana Cvijića od 12:00 časova, dana 15. maja.

text_translations.en: Buses on lines 11a and 11b are running again on the regular route through Jovana Cvijić Street from 12:00 on May 15.

sections.text: Ostale linije 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30  i dalje saobraćaju izmenjenim trasama u navedenom delu grada zbog radova u Kisačkoj ulici.

text_translations.en: Other lines 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 continue to operate on modified routes in the mentioned part of the city due to the works in Kisačka street.

title_translations.en: Lines 11A, 11B - Established traffic through Jovana Cvijić Street

title: Linije 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Maksima Gorkog od 14.04.

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 14. aprila 2026. godine, pa do završetka radova u Ulici Maksima Gorkog, privremeno se menja trasa autobuskih linija 11A i 11B.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from April 14, 2026, until the completion of the works in Maksima Gorki Street, the route of bus lines 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed.

sections.text: LINIJA 11A  (Ž.stanica-Bolnica-Liman-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: LINE 11A (Train station-Hospital-Liman-Train station)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar cara Lazara/Stražilovska autobusi će produžavati pravo Bulevarom cara Lazara, zatim Kejom žrtava racija do raskrsnice sa Ulicom Maksima Gorkog i dalje nastavljati ranije izmenjenom trasom zbog radova na Keju.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Tsar Lazar Boulevard/Stražilovska, buses will continue straight along Tsar Lazar Boulevard, then along the Raid Victims Quay to the intersection with Maksima Gorki Street, and continue along the previously changed route due to works on the Quay.

sections.text: LINIJA 11B (Ž.stanica- Liman-Bolnica-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: LINE 11B (Train station - Liman - Hospital - Train station)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kej žrtava racija/Maksima Gorkog autobusi će saobraćati pravo Kejom žrtava racija, zatim Bulevarom cara Lazara do raskrsnice sa Stražilovskom ulicom, te dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Raid Victims Quay/Maksim Gorki, buses will drive straight along Raid Victims Quay, then Tsar Lazar Boulevard to the intersection with Stražilovska Street, and then continue on the regular route.

title_translations.en: Lines 11A, 11B – Temporary change of route in Maksima Gorki Street from 14.04.

title: Linije 6, 11A, 11B – Izmena trase na Beogradskom keju od 06. 04. (1. faza)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 06. 04. 2026. godine do završetka prve faze radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog vrelovoda GRS-TO JUG od Varadinskog mosta do Ulice Marka Miljanova, privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 6, 11A i 11B.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from April 6, 2026, until the completion of the first phase of works on the reconstruction of the connecting hot water pipeline GRS-TO JUG from Varadinski bridge to Marka Miljanova Street, the routes of bus lines number 6, 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed.

sections.text: Linija 6

text_translations.en: Line 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Filipa Višnjića skretati desno u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, levo u Kosovsku ulicu, levo na Trg republike, nastavljati pravo Ulicom Miloša Bajića, skretati desno na Beogradski kej i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom kretanja. Polasci do „Danubiusa“ neće saobraćati.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Marka Miljanova Street, left to Kosovska Street, left to Trg Republike, continue straight along Miloša Bajić Street, turn right to Beogradski Kej and continue along the regular route. Departures to "Danubius" will not operate.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U KOSOVSKOJ ULICI (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA IZ ULICE MARKA MILJANOVA) I ISPRED DOMA VOJSKE NA BEOGRADSKOM KEJU (NAKON DESNOG SKRETANJA IZ ULICE MILOŠA BAJIĆA).

text_translations.en: TEMPORARY STOPS WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE IN KOSOVSKÁ STREET (AFTER THE LEFT TURN FROM MARKO MILJANOVA STREET) AND IN FRONT OF THE ARMY HOME ON BELGRADE QUAY (AFTER THE RIGHT TURN FROM MILOŠA BAJIĆA STREET).

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will operate on a regular route.

sections.text: Linija 11A (Smer Ž.stanica-Bolnica-Liman-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: Line 11A (Direction Train Station-Hospital-Liman-Train Station)

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Beogradskog keja skretati levo u Ulicu Miloša Bajića, nastavljati pravo Trgom republike, skretati desno u Kosovsku ulicu i dalje saobraćati pravo redovnom trasom do Temerinske ulice gde će skretati levo, zatim desno u Kisačku ulicu, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i produžavati do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Beogradski Quay into Miloša Bajić Street, continue straight along Trg Republike, turn right into Kosovska Street and continue straight along the regular route to Temerinska Street, where they will turn left, then right into Kisačka Street, left onto Kralja Petra I Boulevard, right onto Liberation Boulevard and continue to their last stop.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE SVA REDOVNA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA, KAO I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U ULICI MILOŠA BAJIĆA (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA SA BEOGRADSKOG KEJA) I TEMERINSKOJ ULICI (NAKON LEVOG SKRETANJA IZ GUNDULIĆEVE ULICE).

text_translations.en: ALL REGULAR STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED SECTION OF THE ROUTE, AS WELL AS TEMPORARY STOPS IN MILOSHA BAJIĆA STREET (AFTER THE LEFT TURN FROM BELGRADE QUAY) AND TEMERINSKA STREET (AFTER THE LEFT TURN FROM GUNDULIĆEVU STREET).

sections.text: Linija 11B (Ž.stanica- Liman-Bolnica-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: Line 11B (Train station - Liman - Hospital - Train station)

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Bulevara Jaše Tomića skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku ulicu, desno u Temerinsku ulicu, levo u Gundulićevu ulicu, nastavljati redovnom trasom do raskrsnice Kosovska/Marka Miljanova, produžavati Kosovskom ulicom, skretati levo na Trg republike, nastavljati pravo Ulicom Miloša Bajića, skretati desno na Beogradski kej i dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: From Bulevar Jaša Tomić, the buses will turn left into Kisačka Street, right into Partizanska Street, right into Temerinska Street, left into Gundulićeva Street, continue along the regular route to the Kosovska/Marka Miljanova intersection, continue along Kosovska Street, turn left onto Trg Republike, continue straight onto Miloša Bajić Street, turn right onto Beogradski Kej and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆE STAJALIŠTE „KISAČKA-PODVOŽNJAK“, KAO I PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA U KOSOVSKOJ ULICI (NAKON RASKRSNICE SA ULICOM MARKA MILJANOVA) I ISPRED DOMA VOJSKE NA BEOGRADSKOM KEJU (NAKON DESNOG SKRETANJA IZ ULICE MILOŠA BAJIĆA).

text_translations.en: THE EXISTING STOP "KISAČKA-PODVOZNJAK" WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED SECTION OF THE ROUTE, AS WELL AS TEMPORARY STOPS IN KOSOVSKÁ STREET (AFTER THE INTERSECTION WITH MARKA MILJANOVA STREET) AND IN FRONT OF THE ARMY HOME ON BELGRADE QUAY (AFTER THE RIGHT TURN FROM MILOSHA BAJIĆ STREET).

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11A, 11B – Change of the route on the Belgrade Quay from April 6 (1st phase)

title: Linije 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 – Izmena trase u Kisačkoj ulici

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, zbog radova u Kisačkoj ulici od 23. 03. privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24 i 30.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the routes of bus lines 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 30 will be temporarily changed due to works in Kisačka Street from 03/23.

sections.text: LINIJE 1, 17

text_translations.en: LINES 1, 17

sections.text: Smer A

text_translations.en: Direction A

sections.text: Linije 1, 17: Autobusi će iz Kisačke ulice skretati desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, zatim desno u Kisačku ulicu, odakle će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Lines 1, 17: From Kisačka Street, buses will turn right onto Jaša Tomića Boulevard, left onto Oslobođenja Boulevard, left onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard, then right into Kisačka Street, from where they will continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Smer B

text_translations.en: Direction B

sections.text: Linija 1: Iz Kisačke ulice autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, zatim levo u Kisačku ulicu, odakle će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Line 1: From Kisačka Street, buses will turn left onto Kralja Petra I Boulevard, right onto Oslobođenja Boulevard, right onto Jaša Tomić Boulevard, then left into Kisačka Street, from where they will continue on their regular route.

sections.text: Linija 17: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Line 17: Regular route.

sections.text: Smer A

text_translations.en: Direction A

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati pravo Bulevarom oslobođenja, skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, zatim desno u  Kisačku ulicu, levo u Temerinsku ulicu  i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will drive straight along Liberation Boulevard, turn left onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard, then right into Kisačka Street, left into Temerinska Street and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Smer B

text_translations.en: Direction B

sections.text: Iz Kisačke ulice autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja i dalje nastavljati pravo do svog poslednjeg stajališta.

text_translations.en: From Kisacka Street, buses will turn left onto Kralja Petra I Boulevard, right onto Oslobodenja Boulevard and continue straight to their last stop.

sections.text: Na linijama 22, 23 i 24 polasci koji saobraćaju do centra, do Zone sever i Zone jug (oba smera), neće menjati trasu kretanja

text_translations.en: On lines 22, 23 and 24, departures that travel to the center, to Zone North and Zone South (both directions), will not change their route

title_translations.en: Lines 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 - Change of route in Kisacka Street

title: Linije 10 i 24 – Privremena izmena režima saobraćaja od 26. 02.

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 26. 02. do 10. 04. 2026. godine menja se trasa autobuske linije broj 10 (Centar – Industrijska zona JUG) i linije 24 na polasku 04:45NKA, zbog privremene zabrane odvijanja saobraćaja na Putu Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, u delu od Privrednikove ulice do Ulice dr Nikole Krstića.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from February 26 to April 10, 2026, the route of bus line number 10 (Center - Industrial zone SOUTH) and line 24 departing at 04:45 NKA will be changed, due to the temporary ban on traffic on the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, in the part from Privrednikova Street to Dr. Nikola Krstić Street.

sections.text: LINIJA 10 (Centar – Industrijska zona JUG)

text_translations.en: LINE 10 (Center - Industrial zone SOUTH)

sections.text: SMER A

text_translations.en: Direction A

sections.text: Sa Puta Novosadskog partizanskog odreda autobusi skreću desno u Ulicu dr Nikole Krstića, levo u Privrednikovu ulicu i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, buses turn right into Dr. Nikola Krstić Street, left into Privrednikova Street and continue on their regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristi se privremeno stajalište u Ulici dr Nikole Krstića, odmah nakon desnog skretanja sa Puta Novosadskog partizanskog odreda.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, a temporary stop is used in Ulica Dr. Nikola Krstića, immediately after the right turn from the road of the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment.

sections.text: Sa Puta Novosadskog partizanskog odreda autobusi skreću desno u Ulicu dr Nikole Krstića, zatim desno u Privrednikovu ulicu i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, buses turn right into Dr. Nikola Krstić Street, then right into Privrednikova Street and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristi se privremeno stajalište u Ulici dr Nikole Krstića, odmah nakon desnog skretanja sa Puta Novosadskog partizanskog odreda.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, a temporary stop is used in Ulica Dr. Nikola Krstića, immediately after the right turn from the road of the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment.

sections.text: SMER B

text_translations.en: Direction B

sections.text: Na okretnici ispred ALBUS-a autobusi produžavaju pravo Privrednikovom ulicom, skreću desno u Ulicu dr Nikole Krstića, levo na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the turnpike in front of ALBUS, buses continue straight along Privrednikova Street, turn right onto Dr. Nikola Krstić Street, left onto Put Novosadski Partisanski Odet Road and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristi se privremeno stajalište u Privrednikovoj ulici (ujedno i početno stajalište), odmah nakon raskrsnice sa  Putem Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, kao i privremeno stajalište u Ulici dr Nikole Krstića, neposredno pre levog skretanja na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, a temporary stop is used in Privrednikova Street (also the starting stop), immediately after the intersection with the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, as well as a temporary stop in Dr. Nikola Krstić Street, just before the left turn onto the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road.

sections.text: NA SVIM NAVEDENIM POLASCIMA PRIVREMENO SE UKIDAJU STAJALIŠTA „PUT NOVOSADSKOG PARTIZANSKOG ODREDA – STANDARD“ (u oba smera)  I  „PUT NOVOSADSKOG PARTIZANSKOG ODREDA – ALBUS“.

text_translations.en: ON ALL THE ABOVE DEPARTURES, THE STOPS "ROAD OF THE NOVI SAD PARTISAN DETACHMENT - STANDARD" (in both directions) AND "ROAD OF THE NOV SADIAN PARTISAN DETACHMENT - ALBUS" ARE TEMPORARILY ABOLISHED.

sections.text: Autobusi iz Privrednikove ulice ne skreću na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, već nastavljaju pravo Privrednikovom ulicom do poslednjeg, privremenog stajališta sa desne strane, koje se nalazi odmah nakon raskrsnice sa Putem Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, a u povratku nastavljaju pravo Privrednikovom ulicom, zatim skreću desno u Ulicu dr Nikole Krstića, levo na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses from Privrednikova Street do not turn onto the Road of the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment, but continue straight along Privrednikova Street to the last, temporary stop on the right, which is located immediately after the intersection with the Road of the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment, and on the way back they continue straight along Privrednikova Street, then turn right into Dr. Nikola Krstić Street, left onto the Road of the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment and continue along the regular route.

title_translations.en: Lines 10 and 24 - Temporary change of traffic regime from February 26.

title: Red vožnje vanrednog prevoza Ranžirna železnička stanica Novi Sad - Centar

sections.text: JGSP "Novi Sad" obaveštava putnike da je uspostavljena vanredna linija od Ranžirne železničke stanice Novi Sad do centra grada (oba smera).

text_translations.en: JGSP "Novi Sad" informs passengers that an emergency line has been established from the Novi Sad Shunting Railway Station to the city center (both directions).

sections.text: Polazno stajalište u smeru iz Novog Sada ka Ranžirnoj železničkoj stanici  je redovno autobusko stajalište je u Šafarikovoj ulici (početno stajalište linije broj 2).

text_translations.en: The starting stop in the direction from Novi Sad to Ranžirna railway station is a regular bus stop in Šafarikova street (initial stop of line number 2).

sections.text: Duž cele trase na vanrednim polascima koristi se stajalište kod apoteke "Tilija" kod Železničke stanice (oba smera).

text_translations.en: Along the entire route, on extraordinary departures, the stop at the pharmacy "Tilija" near the railway station (both directions) is used.

sections.text: U skladu sa ugovorom sa „Srbijavozom“, na navedenoj relaciji prevoz  je BESPLATAN.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the contract with "Srbijavoz", transportation on the specified route is FREE.

title: Red vožnje na vanrednim polascima Železnička stanica Petrovaradin - Centar od 14. 01.

sections.text:
Kao ispomoć redovnim linijama 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 i 63 i dalje su na snazi vanredni, direktni polasci autobusa sa autobuskog stajališta „Petrovaradin/Železnička stanica“ u Preradovićevoj ulici (oba smera). Autobusi iz Petrovaradina do centra saobraćaju do stajališta kod SNP-a, a iz centra do Petrovaradina sa polaznog stajališta linije 12 u Šafarikovoj ulici ().

Duž cele trase vanredni polasci u oba smera saobraćaju direktno, ne koristeći ostala stajališta.

Shodno ugovoru sa „Srbijavozom“, na navedenoj relaciji prevoz je BESPLATAN.

text_translations.en:
In addition to the regular lines 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 and 63, extraordinary, direct bus departures from the "Petrovaradin/Railway Station" bus stop in Preradovićeva Street (both directions) are still in force. Buses from Petrovaradin to the center run to the bus stop near SNP, and from the center to Petrovaradin from the departure stop of line 12 in Šafarikova street ().

Along the entire route, extraordinary departures in both directions operate directly, without using other stops.

According to the contract with "Srbijavoz", transportation on the mentioned route is FREE.

title: Linija 9A privremeno preusmerena do okretnice u Petrovaradinu

sections.text:
Zbog preusmeravanja železničkog saobraćaja na Železničku stanicu Petrovaradin, obaveštavamo putnike da je zbog rasterećenja postojećih linija autobusa, linija 9A u smeru od Alibegovca produžena do petrovaradinske okretnice linija 3 i 9, odakle dalje saobraća redovnom trasom do Novog naselja. 

Podsećamo putnike da je na relaciji Šafarikova ulica - Železnička stanica Petrovaradin uvedena vanredna linija na kojoj je prevoz BESPLATAN, te da su građanima pored gradskih linija za prevoz do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin na raspolaganju i međumesne linije 60, 61, 62 i 63 koje kreću sa Međumesne autobuske stanice.

text_translations.en:
Due to the rerouting of railway traffic to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, we inform passengers that due to the relief of existing bus lines, line 9A in the direction of Alibegovec has been extended to the Petrovaradin turnpike of lines 3 and 9, from where it runs on a regular route to New Settlement. 

We remind passengers that an extraordinary line has been introduced on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station, where transport is FREE, and that in addition to the city lines for transport to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, intercity lines 60, 61, 62 and 63 are available to citizens, which depart from the Intercity Bus Station.

title_translations.en: Line 9A temporarily diverted to the turnpike in Petrovaradin
